subject: Renewal roadmap: compressed QBR + recording preference
messages:
From: Elaine Nguyen <elaine.nguyen@northbridgehealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: scheduling@northbridgehealth.com
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal / roadmap QBR — can we compress to one hour?

Hi Irene,

Thanks again for the partnership — our fiscal renewal lands in October and the execs have asked for a tight, single-hour roadmap + product demo rather than the usual 90–120 minute session. The ask is: 60 minutes, focused product walkthrough (30 min) + roadmap highlights and next steps (20 min) + 10 min for Q&A and procurement check-in.

High-level constraints:
- Prefer morning windows (PST) for our execs, avoiding 8–9am PT.
- Would like the session recorded, but one of our Sr. Dir.s may opt-out of recording — we need a plan on how to handle that on your side.
- We’ll need a revised run-of-show and a lightly redlined amendment to the active renewal SOW.

Candidate slots next week (all PT):
- Tue 9/18 10:30–11:30am
- Wed 9/19 9:30–10:30am
- Thu 9/20 11:00–12:00pm

Can you confirm availability and who from Redwood would lead the product portion vs the roadmap/strategy portion? Also, is there any required prep for a short hands-on lab or breakout?

Thanks — Elaine
Elaine Nguyen
Head of Procurement, Northbridge Health
elaine.nguyen@northbridgehealth.com
From: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
To: Elaine Nguyen <elaine.nguyen@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal / roadmap QBR — can we compress to one hour?

Hi Elaine — thanks for the clear constraints. We can absolutely run a tight 60-minute format. Quick responses to your asks:

- Availability: Wed 9/19 9:30–10:30am PT works best for our exec and product leads. I’ll hold that tentatively and send a calendar placeholder once you confirm.
- Hosts: Laura Bennett will lead the product walkthrough (she’ll handle the demo and live scenario), I’ll cover roadmap and adoption / commercial next steps (including the renewal amendment points). Rishi will join for any technical questions that require deep dive.
- Recording: We can record the session but implement a targeted redaction approach — we’ll stop recording during any segment you flag for opt-out, and we’ll capture the rest for internal use. Please note that we’ll still need a brief session note for your procurement team.
- Hands-on lab: Not required given the compressed slot; we suggest a 1–2 minute live example during the demo, but no separate breakout. If you want a short sandbox after the main session, we can offer a 30-minute follow-up with an engineer.

Attached: Agenda_v1.pdf (compact run-of-show). I’ll coordinate with legal for a draft amendment and share the contract redline by EOD tomorrow.

Next steps: If 9/19 9:30am PT is acceptable, confirm and I’ll send a calendar invite with a concise run-of-show and recording guidance.

Best,
Irene Choi
Head of Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com, Elaine Nguyen <elaine.nguyen@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 12 Sep 2028 11:19:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal / roadmap QBR — can we compress to one hour?

Quick note from the product side — I’ll keep the demo tightly scoped to three scenarios: (1) low-latency inference on mixed workloads, (2) cost controls and batching examples, and (3) a short template-driven prompt workflow for care-team summaries. I’ll time each to ~8 minutes to leave space for roadmap and Q&A.

Logistics ask for your scheduling team:
- Please include meeting dial-in and a single calendar attendee list (execs + procurement) so we can manage recording permissions.
- If an executive does request recording opt-out, flag the attendee name and we’ll pause recording during their segment (we’ll include a timestamped note).

I’ll slot in a mock run-through with Rishi tomorrow at 2pm PT; if anything changes I’ll update the run_of_show.xlsx and re-share.

— Laura
From: scheduling@northbridgehealth.com
